capabilities: Create notes from templates or SQL query rows
disambiguation: Not an inventory or packing-list tool; it edits and renders Knap templates.
extras: Query blocks run when drawn and must be reopened to rerun; no network requests or background tasks.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to edit, test, and preview Knap templates or turn their fields and query results into notes.

relations.evidence: With the VaultQuery plugin, query runs a SQL query and applies the template to each row.
The suggestions and delimiter pairing in src/vendor are copied from the Knap playground.

summary: Editor, tester and note creator for Knap templates that renders previews, builds field forms, and creates notes from templates or SQL query rows.
